mission.headline: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to create a thriving community where students transform ideas into real-world solutions. Through mentorship, live projects, hackathons, technical workshops, and competitive programming, we help members develop industry-ready skills, strengthen problem-solving abilities, and build impactful portfolios for internships, placements, and entrepreneurship.

items.question: Who can join CodeX?
items.answer: Any Quantum University student with an interest in technology, coding, innovation, or related fields can join CodeX.

items.question: Do I need prior coding experience?
items.answer: No. CodeX welcomes students of all skill levels, from beginners to experienced developers.

items.question: What is CodeX?
items.answer: CodeX is the technical and coding club of Quantum University, focused on building technical skills through events, workshops, competitions, projects, and collaborative learning.

items.question: Which technologies can I learn through CodeX?
items.answer: CodeX covers a wide range of areas including programming, web development, app development, AI/ML, cybersecurity, cloud, open source, robotics, and emerging technologies.

items.question: Can students from non-technical backgrounds join?
items.answer: Yes. Students from any discipline can join if they are interested in technology and willing to learn.

items.question: Do I need to be a member to attend CodeX events?
items.answer: It depends on the event. Some activities may be open to all students, while others may be specifically for CodeX members.

items.question: What activities does CodeX organize?
items.answer: CodeX organizes hackathons, coding competitions, technical workshops, project showcases, seminars, talks, bootcamps, and other technology-focused activities.

items.question: How can I stay updated about upcoming events?
items.answer: Follow CodeX on our official social media channels and join our student communication groups to receive updates about upcoming events, registrations, and opportunities.

items.question: Where can I find details about upcoming events?
items.answer: Event details, registration links, schedules, and updates are shared through the CodeX website and our official communication channels.

items.question: Can I participate in CodeX hackathons and competitions?
items.answer: Yes. Students can participate in CodeX hackathons, coding competitions, and other technical challenges according to the eligibility criteria of each event.

items.question: Can I attend workshops if I am a beginner?
items.answer: Yes. Many CodeX workshops are designed to help students learn from the basics and build practical skills.

items.question: Does CodeX organize events with other organizations or companies?
items.answer: Yes. CodeX collaborates with companies, student teams, technical communities, and other organizations to conduct workshops, showcases, competitions, and other technical initiatives.

items.question: Can I suggest an event or workshop topic?
items.answer: Yes. Students can share their ideas and suggestions with the CodeX team. Relevant ideas may be considered for future activities.

items.question: Is there a membership fee?
items.answer: Yes. CodeX membership requires a one-time fee of ₹50.

items.question: How long is the membership valid?
items.answer: CodeX membership is valid for the entire academic year.

items.question: How can I become a CodeX member?
items.answer: Students can register through the official CodeX membership registration process when applications are open.

items.question: What do I get as a CodeX member?
items.answer: Members get access to CodeX activities, technical learning opportunities, competitions, workshops, networking opportunities, and opportunities to contribute to club projects and initiatives.

items.question: Can I join CodeX after the membership registration period?
items.answer: Membership availability depends on the club's current registration cycle. Follow CodeX's official channels for announcements.

items.question: Is CodeX membership useful for building my technical profile?
items.answer: Yes. Active members can gain practical experience by participating in projects, competitions, events, and organizing technical activities.

items.question: How can I become a part of the CodeX core team?
items.answer: CodeX generally opens core-team recruitment forms during the even semester. Recruitment announcements are shared through our official communication channels.

items.question: Who can apply for the core team?
items.answer: Eligible CodeX members can apply when recruitment opens. Selection is based on factors such as skills, interest, contribution, responsibility, and involvement in club activities.

items.question: What roles are available in the core team?
items.answer: Depending on the recruitment cycle, roles may include technical development, event management, design, marketing, content, social media, sponsorship, and other operational responsibilities.

items.question: Do I need to be an expert to join the core team?
items.answer: No. Strong interest, willingness to learn, reliability, and active contribution matter more than simply having advanced technical skills.

items.question: Can I contribute to CodeX without being on the core team?
items.answer: Yes. Students can contribute by volunteering at events, participating in projects, helping with technical activities, and supporting club initiatives.

items.question: How can my company sponsor a CodeX event?
items.answer: Companies interested in sponsoring CodeX can contact us through the website contact form or email us at codex.club@quantumeducation.in.

items.question: What are the benefits of sponsoring CodeX?
items.answer: Sponsors can gain brand visibility among 500+ technology-focused students, recruitment and talent-engagement opportunities, event branding, student interaction, and opportunities to showcase their products or services.

items.question: Can companies collaborate with CodeX without providing financial sponsorship?
items.answer: Yes. We are open to collaborations such as technical sessions, workshops, project showcases, mentorship, challenges, goodies, and other mutually beneficial initiatives.

items.question: Can external technical communities or student teams collaborate with CodeX?
items.answer: Yes. CodeX welcomes collaborations with technical communities, student teams, institutions, and organizations for workshops, project showcases, knowledge-sharing sessions, and other technical initiatives.

items.question: How can I propose a collaboration with CodeX?
items.answer: Send your proposal through our website contact form or email codex.club@quantumeducation.in with details about the organization, proposed collaboration, and requirements.
